description: Computing integer powers of complex numbers by converting to trigonometric form and applying De Moivre's formula z^n = r^n(cos n theta + i sin n theta), including MCQ power computations, sums of conjugate powers, and geometric-series-of-powers sums.

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math textbook, De Moivre power exercises spanning two scanned volumes (continuous question numbering) — exercises only
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-25

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given } z = 1+i \text{. The value of } z^{100} \text{ is:} \quad \text{(ក) } -2^{50} \quad \text{(ខ) } 2^{50} \quad \text{(គ) } 2^{50}i \quad \text{(ង) } -2^{50}i \quad \text{(ច) other answer}
exercises.technique: De Moivre: convert to trig form then z^n = r^n(cos n theta + i sin n theta)

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given } z = \cos\frac{\pi}{12}+i\sin\frac{\pi}{12} \text{. Calculate } z^{100} \text{:} \quad \text{(ក) } \cos\frac{\pi}{4}+i\sin\frac{\pi}{4} \quad \text{(ខ) } \cos\frac{\pi}{3}+i\sin\frac{\pi}{3} \quad \text{(គ) } \cos\frac{\pi}{6}+i\sin\frac{\pi}{6} \quad \text{(ង) } \cos\frac{3\pi}{4}+i\sin\frac{3\pi}{4} \quad \text{(ច) other answer}
exercises.technique: De Moivre: (cos theta + i sin theta)^n = cos(n theta) + i sin(n theta), reduce n*theta mod 2*pi

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given } x \in \mathbb{R} \text{. Compute } \dfrac{\left(\cos\frac{x}{2}+i\sin\frac{x}{2}\right)^7}{\left(\cos\frac{2x}{3}+i\sin\frac{2x}{3}\right)^5} \text{:} \quad \text{(ក) } \cos\frac{x}{6}+i\sin\frac{x}{6} \quad \text{(ខ) } \cos\frac{5x}{6}+i\sin\frac{5x}{6} \quad \text{(គ) } \cos\frac{2x}{3}+i\sin\frac{2x}{3} \quad \text{(ង) } \cos\frac{7x}{6}+i\sin\frac{7x}{6} \quad \text{(ច) other answer}
exercises.technique: De Moivre on numerator and denominator, then quotient of trig-form powers

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given } z = \sqrt{2+\sqrt{2}}+i\sqrt{2-\sqrt{2}} \text{. The value of } z^{14} \text{ is:} \quad \text{(ក) } 2^{14}\left(\cos\frac{7\pi}{4}+i\sin\frac{7\pi}{4}\right) \quad \text{(ខ) } 2^{14}\left(\cos\frac{3\pi}{4}+i\sin\frac{3\pi}{4}\right) \quad \text{(គ) } 2^{14}\left(\cos\frac{5\pi}{4}+i\sin\frac{5\pi}{4}\right) \quad \text{(ង) } 2^{14}\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{4}+i\sin\frac{\pi}{4}\right) \quad \text{(ច) other answer}
exercises.technique: convert z to trig form via half-angle identities, then apply De Moivre

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Let } Z = \cos\frac{2\pi}{7} + i\sin\frac{2\pi}{7}. \text{ Write } w = (1+z)^6 \text{ in trigonometric form.}
exercises.technique: Add 1 to a point on the unit circle (use half-angle/sum-to-product identities to write 1+z in trig form), then apply De Moivre's formula to raise to the 6th power.

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Write the complex number } w = -\frac{1}{2}+i\frac{1}{2} \text{ in trigonometric form, then calculate } w^4, \text{ writing the result in algebraic form.}
exercises.technique: Compute modulus and argument of w, apply De Moivre's formula for the 4th power, then convert the result back to algebraic form.
